name: pagination
title: Pagination
description: Page-navigation control: numbered pages with prev/next + ellipsis (full), a 'Page N of M' live label (compact), or arrow-only prev/next (simple). The host element IS the <nav> landmark (role=navigation + aria-label=Pagination), exactly like the Light-DOM WC. Button mode fires hbd:change -> onChange/onPageChange and updates the controlled `page`; link mode renders <a href> from `hrefPrefix` with the current page as a <span aria-current=page>. Optional first/last jump buttons, a 'Showing X-Y of Z' info readout, a 'Page [input] Go' goto cluster (Enter or click submits), and a page-size <select> built from @hbd/select whose change resets the page to 1 and fires hbd:page-size-change -> onPageSizeChange. Boundary prev/next stay focusable with aria-disabled=true. Controlled-first: page + onPageChange + defaultPage uncontrolled fallback.
